summary: Tested adjustable nearby-radius feature (10/25/50 km). Backend 100% passing (8/8 pytest incl. validation, cutoffs at 10/25/50, cleanup). Frontend: radius row renders, pills toggle correctly, cyan ring active state works, toasts fire, persistence via /auth/me works. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: after radius-only change, closing the screen via X does NOT reload the feed — the X button is wired to `onClose` instead of `handleClose`, so the `radiusDirty → onChanged` branch is never taken. Verified: reload of app does reflect new radius (backend/persistence fine), but the in-app close-to-refresh flow specified in the requirements is broken.

ui_bugs.issue: Close (X) button uses onClick={onClose} instead of onClick={handleClose}. When only the radius changed (radiusDirty=true), handleClose was designed to route through onChanged(freshUser||user) so the parent reloads the feed with the new radius. Because the X calls onClose directly, no /api/feed request fires on close and the feed remains stale until the user manually reloads. Verified: after tapping 10 km and closing, 0 /api/feed requests observed and feed still shows all 3 Marlton nearby cards (should show only Voorhees 3 KM).

integration_issues.issue: Feed never reloads on close after radius-only change; requirement 'closing the screen after a radius-only change routes through onChanged so the feed reloads' is NOT met.

action_items: Change ChangeLocationScreen.js line 390: onClick={onClose} → onClick={handleClose} on the X close button so that radiusDirty branch fires onChanged (feed reloads).
Optional: cover this with a unit/integration test — mock onChanged/onClose and verify handleClose picks the right one based on radiusDirty.
critical_code_review_comments: ChangeLocationScreen.js:389-396 — `handleClose` is declared but the X button still calls the raw `onClose` prop. Dead code + broken feature. Small fix, big impact.
Consider also intercepting the modal-scrim/backdrop close (if any) and Escape-key close to go through handleClose.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded Marlton nearby users: Voorhees 3.1km, Cherry Hill 10.5km, test-john-erial 15.2km).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint POST /api/users/nearby-radius {10|25|50} works and persists as users.nearby_radius_km; feed cutoff verified against seeded distances. Frontend regression: verify X close (change-location-close) after a radius-only tap triggers a /api/feed request AND updates the feed cards (Marlton + radius 10 should show only 1 card 'Voorhees 3 KM').
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/screens/ChangeLocationScreen.js the close button (line 389-396) is `onClick={onClose}` but the file defines `handleClose` (line 49-52) that inspects `radiusDirty` and calls `onChanged(freshUser||user)` when only the radius changed. The X handler was never switched to `handleClose`, so the radius-only close path never triggers the parent's feed reload. Repro: sign in as demo-00, set browsing city to Marlton via API, open change-location, tap 10 km (toast shows, aria-pressed flips), tap X → screen closes but no /api/feed fires and feed still shows all 3 nearby users (should be 1). Fix: `onClick={handleClose}` on the close button.
